payload.walk:
EACH QUALITY SCENARIO WALKED THROUGH THE MATRICES. Verdicts are addressed / at-risk / unaddressed, and I have used all three rather than declaring everything addressed.

QS1 FRESHNESS (from criterion C1, veto). Source: the agent. Stimulus: it searches for content it wrote seconds ago and has not staged. Artifact: E1. Environment: normal. Response: the content is found. Measure: found on the first call, with no staging step.
VERDICT: **ADDRESSED**, carried by se.adr-untracked-files-are-searched-by-default. Note this was AT-RISK until that ADR - git's own default would have failed this scenario silently, and the scenario is the agent's single most common pattern. Recording that the design changed to meet it rather than that it happened to.

QS2 GUIDANCE ARRIVES (from R14, need N3). Source: an arriving session with no memory of this project. Stimulus: it reaches a state to which a law applies. Artifact: E5. Environment: any session. Response: the law arrives in the packet, resolved. Measure: present without the agent searching for it.
VERDICT: **ADDRESSED** by E5 plus se.adr-applies-to-becomes-a-selector - CONDITIONAL on the ten-node migration actually happening. If the migration lands and authoring discipline lapses later, this degrades quietly: new laws simply stop matching. That is a maintenance risk rather than a design hole, and it is the reason R21's collect-the-scan sibling matters - a field nothing collects is a field that rots.

QS3 THE PACKET STAYS READABLE (R15). Source: the agent. Stimulus: many rules match one state. Artifact: E5. Environment: a mature ledger. Response: the instruction remains findable. Measure: guidance volume reported per packet.
VERDICT: **AT RISK**, and honestly so. E5 reports the size, which makes the cost visible - it does not bound it. Nothing in this baseline stops a state from matching twelve rules. Measurement is the first move because we do not yet know the real distribution, but 'we will see it happen' is weaker than 'it cannot happen', and I am not going to score it as addressed. Carried as se.raid-the-guidance-join-buries-the-instruction with ranking-by-specificity as the recorded fallback.

QS4 NO LINT PARKS A RUN (R17, need N7). Source: an unattended iteration at 3am. Stimulus: a check the machine cannot compute. Artifact: E6. Environment: owner absent. Response: the run continues. Measure: no third outcome exists in the registry.
VERDICT: **ADDRESSED** structurally rather than by policy - the verdict type has three members and none of them blocks. A property that cannot be violated by a careless lint author beats a rule that asks them to be careful.

QS5 THE AUDIT DISTINGUISHES COMPUTED FROM ASSERTED (R20, need N9). Source: the owner, days later. Stimulus: reviewing a delegated bless. Artifact: E6 -> E7 (I6). Environment: after the fact. Response: computed checks are identifiable. Measure: identifiable without reading prose.
VERDICT: **ADDRESSED** by the separate verdict block. The residue worth naming: it proves a check RAN and what it found; it does not prove the check was WORTH running. A weak lint reporting pass is indistinguishable, to the auditor, from a strong one. That is not fixable by this interface and it is why the lint-quality question belongs to review rather than to the record.

QS6 A SEARCH NEVER FLOODS OR HANGS (R28). Source: any caller. Stimulus: a pathological pattern or a huge file. Artifact: E1/E2. Environment: normal. Response: a capped answer or a bounded refusal. Measure: bounded time, result count and line width.
VERDICT: **AT RISK**, because git grep provides none of these natively and every cap must be built at our boundary - which is code that can be forgotten in one path. Weaker than ripgrep would have been here; that cost was visible in the scoring as C6 and was accepted knowingly.

QS7 THE RECORD SURVIVES CARELESSNESS (need N8). Source: anyone. Stimulus: every iter/* tag deleted, or a push without the flag. Artifact: E7. Environment: any clone. Response: evidence still reachable. Measure: reachable by hash from trunk.
VERDICT: **ADDRESSED**, and the strongest of the seven, because reachability rests on the merge's second parent rather than on any name - a property, not a procedure.

QS8 THE LANE BEATS THE ALTERNATIVE (the goal G1). Source: the agent. Stimulus: work that a script could do. Artifact: the whole surface. Environment: any iteration. Response: the lane is the faster path. Measure: hand-rolled workarounds per iteration.
VERDICT: **UNADDRESSED BY CONSTRUCTION**, and correctly so - no architecture can carry it. It is measured on the NEXT iteration, not this one, which is exactly why it was chosen as a validation signal rather than a check. Naming it unaddressed rather than quietly dropping it.
payload.fitness_candidates:
MEASURABLE SCENARIOS THAT COULD AUTOMATE AT M7 - stated as the check they would become, with the ones that CANNOT automate named too.

F-a (QS1, freshness): create a file, leave it unstaged, search its content, expect a hit. Fully automatable and it directly guards the ADR that rescued QS1.
F-b (QS4, no parking): assert that the lint verdict type admits exactly pass, fail and defer - a type-level or registry-level check, so a future lint CANNOT introduce a fourth outcome. This is the fitness function I trust most, because it constrains authors rather than testing behaviour.
F-c (QS5, audit): read a grant and assert computed checks are identifiable without parsing prose.
F-d (QS7, record survives): in a fixture repo, delete every tag, then resolve the evidence by hash from trunk. Destructive, so fixture-only.
F-e (QS6, bounds): feed a pathological pattern and an oversized file; assert a capped answer or a bounded refusal, and assert elapsed time stays under the bound. Partly automatable - the time bound is measurable, the pathological-pattern space is not exhaustible.
F-f (QS3, volume): report guidance size per packet and assert it is present. Measures rather than bounds, which is exactly the weakness QS3 was scored at-risk for; the fitness function inherits the limitation rather than curing it.
F-g (R8/E3): call a tool with a wrong argument name and assert a typed refusal, never a coerced value. Directly guards the witnessed defect.

NOT AUTOMATABLE, named so nobody expects them: QS8's workarounds-per-iteration is measured across iterations by a human reading the record; QS2's authoring discipline cannot be tested, only its mechanism can; and the residue in QS5 - whether a lint was worth running - is a review judgement by construction.
